bridgeRouteRisk.summary: Noon documents Ethereum sUSN as the canonical ERC-4626 wrapper and lock chain: sUSN inventory is locked on Ethereum, destination Hyperlane representations mint on accepted messages, and return transfers burn the representation before Ethereum unlocks the original. The zkSync, Sophon, and Starknet deployments are bridge representations, while Ethereum bridge configuration, pause/correction, upgrade, mailbox/ISM, and destination owner controls are scored here separately from native deposit-gated issuance.

controls.label: Noon sUSN Ethereum lockbox and Hyperlane route Safe

routeChecks.lockboxOrEscrow: Noon documents Ethereum-to-destination lock-mint and destination-to-Ethereum burn-unlock. At Ethereum block 25771191, the current ERC-4626 cross-chain path locks wrapper inventory on Ethereum and unlocks it only after an accepted Hyperlane message; this is supply-conserving bridge escrow, not independent issuer-native minting.
routeChecks.trustedPeerOrRemote: The current implementation exposes owner-authorized Hyperlane mailbox, ISM, and remote-token configuration. The Ethereum mailbox is 0xc005dc82818d67af737725bd4bf75435d065d239, interchainSecurityModule() returns zero so the mailbox default ISM is effective, and the LayerZero Endpoint V2 is 0x1a44076050125825900e736c501f859c50fe728c. The default ISM validator set and quorum were not decoded.
routeChecks.pausersAdminsUpgraders: The Noon Safe owns the wrapper and administers the bridge configuration. The current implementation adds pause and a 48-hour stuck-message correction flow. Bridge-critical implementation replacement passes through ProxyAdmin 0x1908284b50ee152c9f00c8e65a81fc1c4520bd81 and timelock 0xe5e412c212b4fbbf550a94e7bd5e83db0b315a7f owned by the same Safe; that timelock currently holds an armed, expiry-free upgrade scheduled 2026-06-10 and executable since 2026-06-12, so the 172800-second delay does not presently bind a bridge-logic change (re-checked 2026-09-22).
routeChecks.onchainAmountBounds: Outbound transfers lock existing sUSN wrapper inventory and accepted return messages unlock that inventory; no independent canonical bridge mint path or route-level aggregate limit was verified.

controls.capDescription: The Noon Safe controls the Ethereum lockbox's bridge administration, Hyperlane/remote-token configuration, pause and stuck-message correction, while the ProxyAdmin/timelock path can replace bridge-critical logic after 172800 seconds; an armed dormant timelock operation scheduled 2026-06-10 currently makes that replacement executable with zero further notice. Native sUSN issuance remains deposit-gated.
